placements.why: The existing leaf Narrative_CalibrationRecordCanBeDeniedOrAskedAway carries the same shape — a record asked away, and the asking read as a claim about the record — but it is scoped to a calibration record, and this document's directives reach past any single record to a whole body of knowledge: 'Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts' and 'Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.' Binding a fleet-and-contracts erasure under a leaf named for a calibration record would misname the support, so the leaf is minted as an extension of that close-but-not-exact theme rather than a reuse. The grain test admits it: wholesale erasure is a subject future envelopes can keep feeding, not a one-time fact. Both segments are carried by the position WholesaleForgetRequest, which is the leaf's sole support.
placements.title: A directive to forget a whole body of knowledge is itself a claim about what was held
placements.frame: When someone directs that an entire body of knowledge be forgotten — a fleet, its contracts, its routes — what does that directive assert about the knowledge, and about whoever is being asked to stop holding it?

mints.name: WholesaleForgetting
mints.title: Directing that an entire body of knowledge be forgotten at once, and what such a directive asserts about what was held
mints.why: No existing stratum holds this grouping: InstrumentCalibration and CalibratedOrNeverCalibrated are about an instrument's calibration state, and NewHireOnboarding and PallasineChecklistParts are about a first week on the job. The witnessed text names a distinct subject — forgetting a whole body of knowledge wholesale ('Forget everything about…', 'Remove all knowledge of…') — which the organization's current strata do not cover.

connections.why: The leaf's theme is exactly the grouping: a directive to forget a whole body of knowledge, read as a claim about that knowledge.
The position holds both directives — the bounded one naming a fleet and its helium procurement contracts, and the sweeping one covering all zeppelin routes — which is the grouping the stratum names.
